description: Explain a coin series, a credited artist or sculptor, or a catalogue year, and list its coins. Covers «coins of the series X», «coins by the artist X» and «coins of 2024», and returns series and person ids.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, with the same other arguments.
cursor.title: Cursor

entity_type.description: series = a coin series; person = an artist or sculptor credited on coins; year = a catalogue year.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

id.description: The entity id (for a year, the year itself). Give id or name, not both.
id.title: Id

name.description: A name or part of it, in Ukrainian, when the id is not known. Not for a year.
name.title: Name

name: get_catalog_entity
title: Series, person or year
